name: Ring of Resistance
description:
You have resistance to one damage type while wearing this ring. The gem in the ring indicates the type, which the GM chooses or determines randomly.

**Table- Ring of Resistance**

| d10 | Damage Type | Gem        |

|-----|-------------|------------|

| 1   | Acid        | Pearl      |

| 2   | Cold        | Tourmaline |

| 3   | Fire        | Garnet     |

| 4   | Force       | Sapphire   |

| 5   | Lightning   | Citrine    |

| 6   | Necrotic    | Jet        |

| 7   | Poison      | Amethyst   |

| 8   | Psychic     | Jade       |

| 9   | Radiant     | Topaz      |

| 10  | Thunder     | Spinel     |

|     |             |            |
